narrative: It is a busy morning at a rural HC III. A patient is added to your queue while other staff are balancing immunizations, ANC visits, and urgent walk-ins. The presenting concern is cough for three weeks. The case is titled 'Adult cough requiring TB screen', but the learner should approach it as an unfolding clinical encounter, not as a diagnosis already made.
